svg.title: Blueprint BP-05, where Seatbelt sits in the vibe-coding loop. You describe an idea, the builder AI writes code, a save point is made, the app is deployed, and people use the live app, which feeds back new ideas. Seatbelt is loaded into the builder AI and adds four gates: G1 plan and risk level before building, G2 the change explainer at each save point, G3 the ship check before deploy, G4 the live check after deploy. If a fix breaks twice, it goes back to the last save point.
